component.name: UdpTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "execute" end sub
sub execute() print "TASK: start" port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") recvAddr = CreateObject("roSocketAddress") recvAddr.setAddress("127.0.0.1:0") recvSocket = CreateObject("roDataGramSocket") recvSocket.setMessagePort(port) bound = recvSocket.setAddress(recvAddr) boundPort = recvAddr.getPort() print "TASK: bound="; bound; " port="; boundPort
sendAddr = CreateObject("roSocketAddress") sendAddr.setAddress("127.0.0.1:" + boundPort.toStr()) sendSocket = CreateObject("roDataGramSocket") sendSocket.setSendToAddress(sendAddr)
recvSocket.notifyReadable(true) sent = sendSocket.sendStr("ping from task") print "TASK: sent="; sent
result = "timeout" timespan = CreateObject("roTimespan") while timespan.TotalMilliseconds() < 3000 event = wait(100, port) if type(event) = "roSocketEvent" and event.getSocketID() = recvSocket.getID() and recvSocket.isReadable() result = recvSocket.receiveStr(1024) exit while end if end while print "TASK: result="; result m.top.content = result ' No Close() calls here on purpose — see source/main.brs. end sub
